publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH or CDC sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, conservative non-diagnostic anatomy or systems orientation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Every PNG was inspected at native 1536 by 1024 resolution; observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: Only the six exact accepted source hashes may be promoted to metadata-bearing lossless masters, article WebP derivatives, and centered contain-mode 1200x630 social WebP derivatives.

assets.scientificFinding: Current inherited progressive neurodegenerative condition with variable movement, cognitive, and behavioral manifestations. A neutral neuroanatomical orientation plate cannot establish diagnosis, pathology, or stage.
assets.visualReview: Three complete teaching groups: one intact lateral brain, one coronal brain cutaway with paired deep structures, and one connected network containing five prominent neuron bodies. No atrophy, lesion, patient, symptom scene, gene symbol, label, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.

assets.scientificFinding: Current umbrella for chronic structural inflammatory bowel disorders including Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis. Selected wall patterns are illustrative, non-universal, and non-diagnostic.
assets.visualReview: Three complete teaching groups: one digestive-tract orientation with colon and coiled small bowel, plus two separate layered bowel-wall cutaways. One cutaway has an even outer wall; the other shows a focal rounded deeper-wall bulge. No blood, ulcer, fistula, abscess, obstruction, label, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.
